// NOT COMPILED. This is the NEGATIVE CONTROL for
// `tests/foreign_facts_are_observed.rs`, and it is a `.rs.txt` on purpose: it
// must be scanned, never built.
//
// It is the shipped shape of `retire_ungranted_successor` at aaf474f06 — the
// late-park commit — reduced to the part the rule is about and otherwise
// verbatim. The defect: `parked` is a claim about ANOTHER THREAD's state (has
// the main thread parked its PTY readers?), it is a literal at every one of the
// six call sites, and a branch on it decides whether the other thread is ever
// woken. When the main thread's park landed during the worker's stand-down the
// wake was never sent and the user's terminal stayed frozen through a 2 s
// grace, a SIGKILL and an unbounded reap.
//
// The live tree finds ZERO candidates now (df183f2f9 removed the parameter and
// made the post unconditional), so without this fixture the gate would be green
// over an empty set and would rot unnoticed the first time someone spells the
// premise as a `match` instead of an `if`. That is the same two-sided
// discipline `assert_proves_and_catches` and `non_vacuity_ratchet.rs` impose:
// a rule that cannot be shown to FIRE has not been shown to be a rule.

fn retire_ungranted_successor(
    job: &HandoffWorkerJob,
    proxy: &winit::event_loop::EventLoopProxy<Wake>,
    nonce: &str,
    held: HeldSuccessor,
    outcome: crate::UpdateHandoffOutcome,
    detail: String,
    parked: bool,
) {
    if parked {
        let _ = proxy.send_event(Wake::UpdateHandoffUnpark {
            attempt_id: job.attempt_id,
        });
    }
    if !worker_claim_handoff_reaper(&job.arbiter) {
        return;
    }
    let candidate = held.candidate;
    let stood = stand_down_held_successor(held, STAND_DOWN_SELF_EXIT_GRACE);
    send_warranted_handoff_failure(stood.warrant, &job.cleanup, proxy, job.current_build);
}

// The six call sites, each passing a LITERAL — which is what makes the
// parameter a premise nobody computes rather than a fact somebody measured.

fn call_site_mismatch() {
    retire_ungranted_successor(
        job,
        proxy,
        &lane,
        held,
        crate::UpdateHandoffOutcome::Rejected,
        detail,
        false,
    );
}

fn call_site_hangup() {
    retire_ungranted_successor(
        job,
        proxy,
        &lane,
        held,
        crate::UpdateHandoffOutcome::ChildDied,
        "the successor closed the rendezvous after dialling".to_string(),
        false,
    );
}

fn call_site_event_loop_closed() {
    retire_ungranted_successor(
        job,
        proxy,
        &lane,
        held,
        crate::UpdateHandoffOutcome::Rejected,
        "event loop closed before the park".to_string(),
        false,
    );
}

fn call_site_hold_stand_down() {
    retire_ungranted_successor(job, proxy, &lane, held, outcome, detail, false);
}

fn call_site_preparation_cancelled() {
    retire_ungranted_successor(
        job,
        proxy,
        &lane,
        held,
        crate::UpdateHandoffOutcome::ActivityRevoked,
        "activity revoked handoff during physical preparation".to_string(),
        true,
    );
}

fn call_site_transfer_failed() {
    retire_ungranted_successor(
        job,
        proxy,
        &lane,
        held,
        crate::UpdateHandoffOutcome::Rejected,
        format!("the handoff descriptors could not be delivered: {error}"),
        true,
    );
}
